live.cacheNote: the figures come from the local cache (~/.claude.json), which only updates when you open /usage in Claude Code
live.okDirect: The app fetches usage directly (every 15 min at most)
live.okDetour: The app fetches usage via a {{via}} detour — direct HTTPS from the app is blocked here (corporate proxy, private CA, …). The figures are current
live.noCredentials: Live fetch failed: could not read credentials — Keychain access was denied/locked, or .credentials.json is missing. $t(activity:usage.live.cacheNote)
live.unauthorizedFile: Live fetch failed: token rejected ({{detail}}) — it fell back to the .credentials.json file token instead of Keychain, and that token may have expired. $t(activity:usage.live.cacheNote)
live.unauthorizedKeychain: Live fetch failed: token rejected ({{detail}}) — you may need to log in again (claude /login). $t(activity:usage.live.cacheNote)
live.unexpected: Live fetch failed: the response shape changed ({{detail}}). $t(activity:usage.live.cacheNote)

codexLive.cacheNote: the figures come from local session records (~/.codex/sessions), which only update when Codex CLI actually runs
codexLive.ok: The app asks codex CLI for usage directly (every 15 min at most)
codexLive.cliMissing: Live fetch failed: codex executable not found (check PATH). $t(activity:usage.codexLive.cacheNote)
codexLive.cliFailed: Live fetch failed: codex exited without a response ({{detail}}). $t(activity:usage.codexLive.cacheNote)
codexLive.timeout: Live fetch failed: codex did not respond in time. $t(activity:usage.codexLive.cacheNote)
codexLive.rpcError: Live fetch failed: codex returned an error ({{detail}}) — you may need to log in (codex login). $t(activity:usage.codexLive.cacheNote)
codexLive.unexpected: Live fetch failed: the codex app-server response shape changed ({{detail}}). $t(activity:usage.codexLive.cacheNote)

antigravityLive.noCacheNote: Antigravity keeps no local usage copy, so a failed lookup leaves the last fetched value — or nothing at all
antigravityLive.ok: Asking the agy CLI directly (at most every 15 minutes)
antigravityLive.cliMissing: Live lookup failed: agy executable not found (check the Antigravity CLI install and PATH). $t(activity:usage.antigravityLive.noCacheNote)
antigravityLive.cliFailed: Live lookup failed: agy exited without a result ({{detail}}). $t(activity:usage.antigravityLive.noCacheNote)
antigravityLive.timeout: Live lookup failed: agy did not answer in time. $t(activity:usage.antigravityLive.noCacheNote)
antigravityLive.commandFailed: Live lookup failed: agy returned an error ({{detail}}) — you may need to sign in (run agy and log in). $t(activity:usage.antigravityLive.noCacheNote)
antigravityLive.unexpected: Live lookup failed: the agy /usage response shape changed ({{detail}}). $t(activity:usage.antigravityLive.noCacheNote)

dialog.title: Usage

empty.claude: No usage data. Open /usage once in Claude Code to create the local cache.
empty.codex: No usage data. Run codex login so the app can fetch it, or run Codex CLI once to create local records.
empty.antigravity: No usage data. Install the Antigravity CLI (agy) and sign in, and the app will fetch it directly.

dialog.allHidden: No usage to show — nothing could be fetched from any CLI for over a day.
